rationale: The only rule-tree change in commit 2a0e452617fc is the replacement of a dead URL under the `références:` key of rule `établissement . taux ATMP` (AT/MP rate of an employer's establishment). `références` is documentation metadata that the publicodes engine does not evaluate: the organisation's engine parses the same 641 raw / 1220 parsed rules on both sides, the parsed rule list is identical, and 69 evaluations covering the AT/MP rules themselves and every rule bound to the twelve articles of the set (auto-entrepreneur rates, ACRE, DROM, RCI, indépendant base, maladie, retraite de base, invalidité-décès, CSG) return byte-identical values before and after. No bounded article mentions accidents du travail or the AT/MP contribution, so the change has no relation to the governing text in force; nothing it touches needs legal support. The remaining four files of the commit are site/ UI sources outside the rule tree.
